info.title: Jiffo API
info.description: Every HTTP route the API serves, generated from its controllers by `pnpm --filter @jiffo/api openapi`; a test fails when this file is out of date. A route with no `security` is open to anyone. `x-rate-limit` is the limit class it counts under (common/rate-limit.ts), `x-apps` the apps whose sign-in it takes, and `x-permission` what an admin role needs. Errors are `{ error: { code, message } }`. Routes behind `DevelopmentOnlyGuard` answer 404 in production. Live updates use a socket.io connection with the app access token (realtime/realtime.gateway.ts), not listed here.

app.description: An access token for the customer or agent app, from sign-in.

admin.description: An admin session token, sent by the admin panel's server.
